answer: Work-dependency chain attestation: each epoch an agent's task input is the prior agent's output hash, so honest work weaves one long chain across the net, like a reef built grain by grain. Three auditors trace each chain: a farm's 1,000 identities feed only each other, so their chains close into a loop on one ridge of the graph and are quarantined together, rewards frozen three epochs. Forging 1,000 outward links needs 1,000 real external collaborators per epoch, about 2,000 hours of real work, while one honest agent takes one link per epoch and pays nothing, its ripple joining the open chain.
